Account snapshot:
- Product: editor-embedded AI for commercial IDEs and cloud workspaces. Primary revenue from enterprise seats + hosted inference credits.
- Use-case focus: ultra-low-latency completions and streaming assistants in the editor. Users expect live streaming while typing (no >100ms perceived lag).
- Key metrics requested: TTFT (time-to-first-token), per-keystroke jitter distribution, end-to-end median latency, and token burn per completion.
- TTFT target: <=80ms first token in NA, <=120ms in EU. Service-level jitter target: p95 <50ms variance.

- Token-budgeting: want per-session token budgets (max_tokens/day per seat) and soft-throttles. Need tooling to tune budget vs. quality; prefer suggestions from Redwood Optimize on quantization/model variants.
- Model/version pinning: critical — dev teams want ability to pin minor versions for deterministic completions across releases and to test canary models in 5% rollouts.
- Fallback policy: fall back to smaller quantized model for cold starts or infra strain, with preference-preserving prefixes. Must preserve syntax correctness.
- Security/compliance: IP retention rules — transient code not stored beyond 24 hours by default; enterprise can opt-out of logging. Must support SSO/SAML and KMS integration.
